case_title: SMT. SHAMIM v. STATE (GNCT OF DELHI)
confession: Voluntary extra judicial confession by the accused
aggravating_circumstances: Strong opposition to marriage, threat to kill family members
neutral_facts: The accused, a woman, was involved in an incident where the brother and mother of the victim were shot dead. The victim's sister, who was injured, testified against the accused. The accused's daughter also testified that the accused had threatened to kill the victim's family if they did not comply with her wishes. The accused was initially acquitted by the trial court, but the High Court reversed this decision, finding motive and credibility in the testimony of the injured witness and the recovery of blood-stained items. The accused was convicted of murder under the relevant sections of the Penal Code.
